notes.title: I want to break FREE
notes.content:
Hi Cybertrons,

After due consideration, I have decided to keep this game available on Steam, but for free. This may take a week or so, as I need to arrange it with the Steam staff.

Best wishes,

Numbered Entity

notes.title: Even New Gods Retire
notes.content:
Hi cyber-people. To these few who have played this experimental, little project, thank you, whatever your thoughts.

With no experience, I took to Ren'py and conjured up this tale. All art, music and story were created by just me alone, making something while trying to learn about games at the same time.

I feel the time has come to retire this starter project from Steam, although it will be available on Itch.io for free in the coming weeks.

Best wishes,

Numbered Entity
